description: This file defines the ContainerLoader class in the Api\Core\Loader namespace. It contains a static method configure() that loads configuration files, sets up a DI container with services, and returns the configured container instance.

classes.name: ContainerLoader
classes.description: Provides a static method to load configuration files and instantiate a DI container with registered services.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Loads Slim settings and container definitions from configuration files, populates a Slim Container with these services, and returns the container instance.
